title: Full pre-consolidation initiation history and substantive changes retained in its live owner
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: complete superseded snapshot preserved; meaningful consolidated changes and later authority mapped to canonical owner
reviews.disposition:
The complete581-line pre-consolidation snapshot was read, including every LI/H/D/operation/LIP/LP/IG/local-AR/M/MX/HG/LW section and its own correction of the early severe-resolver overreach. Keep this historical supplier unchanged. It preserves the former sequence of risk interpretations, original six-unit draft and then-proposed compatibility wording; it does not restore planning-only scope, R4 ownership or runtime-absent claims after the live owner's Oct19 delivery. Its relative hrefs intentionally retain the former gm-file base and are historical locators, not working same-folder links or fresh source/transfer instructions. The canonical owner remains this file, with the later source/native/remainder updates and B517 full review.

Consolidation made substantive clarifications, not mere relocation. S1–S5 freeze a useful second target and actual return-with-finding custody consumer; S3 pins finite prepared-dose prehistory without retaining/double-debiting consumed inputs; D3 explicitly states five-minute performed lesson and one-minute bounded use, with start-spend versus completion-learning semantics. D4's shared completion clock excludes a direct time setter; no importing a prior completion can award again. The compatibility language changes from preferred plan to resolved behavioral contract without blindly choosing schema12. UI/current ownership recovery uses the later R5 return rather than assuming the old R4 transfer is live. These differences do not themselves establish runtime behavior; the later engine/native entries and their input-specific receipts do that at their recorded scope. The archive's possible table/phase ambiguity is not authority to duplicate sources, inventory or resources.

Retain the original useful ideas: committed ingestion distinct from unfinished teaching, canon-led hazards without invented percentages/catastrophe branches, limited observations distinct from safety/identity, actual teacher/body/sample support, institutional suppliers versus clubs/back rooms/remote exchange, private audiences, real offers versus promises/settlement and mundane space/literacy/availability/spendable-money details. Hosting is a recorded means-dependent user direction, while exact HG schema/two contacts/trust/terms/priority remain proposals; markets are not prerequisites for initiation. Local auditAR1–AR11 is a document-specific checklist, not the registered architecture rule family. Current AD42 removes mandatory human feel as a hard gate; current desktop scope retires1366as universal target; current PROJECT supersedes all old build-first instructions. Full old-draft review adds preservation and change-history coverage, not renewed source qualification, startup authorization, a new native wave or proof of its proposed APIs. No underlying EPUB, current source, prior private save, transfer file or browser was accessed.
reviews.evidence: Whole581-line archive read in four bounded ranges; canonical698-line body freshly reviewed in B517. Raw snapshot stays unchanged, including its intentionally old relative-link base.
reviews.reopen: Use canonical current native/phase owner and recorded implementation evidence, not the old draft, for any selected code/source or compatibility work.
